meta.name: animation-systems
meta.description: Expert in real-time game animation systems including skeletal animation, blend trees, state machines, inverse kinematics, root motion, procedural animation, and animation retargeting. Specializes in creating fluid, responsive character animation that balances visual quality with performance constraints. Use when "animation system, state machine, blend tree, skeletal animation, inverse kinematics, IK system, root motion, animation blending, character animation, animator controller, motion matching, animation retargeting, foot IK, look at IK, aim offset, animation montage, animation notify, additive animation, animation layers, procedural animation, animation, game-dev, character, state-machine, unity, unreal, godot, skeletal, rigging, motion" mentioned.

copy.tagline: 创建流畅的游戏角色动画系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为游戏角色设计动画状态机和混合树。
copy.tagline_en: Create fluid character animation systems for games
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing animation state machines and blend trees for game characters.

howto.what: 装上后，当你询问游戏角色动画相关问题时，Claude 会以资深动画专家的身份回答，帮你设计、调试或优化骨骼动画、状态机、混合树、逆向动力学等系统，并兼顾性能。
howto.when: 当你提到“动画系统”、“状态机”、“骨骼动画”等关键词，或要求设计、调试角色动画时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个角色从站立到跑步的动画状态机。
say.note: Claude 会给出状态节点和转换条件的设计。

say.text: 如何用逆向动力学让角色脚贴地？
say.note: Claude 会解释 IK 方案和实现要点。

say.text: 动画混合树和状态机有什么区别？
say.note: Claude 会对比两者适用场景。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude behaves as a veteran animation programmer, answering questions about real-time game animation systems like skeletal animation, state machines, blend trees, IK, etc., helping you balance visual quality and performance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords such as "animation system," "state machine," "skeletal animation," or ask for help designing or debugging character animation.

say_en.text: Design a state machine for a character transitioning from idle to run.
say_en.note: Claude will outline states and transition conditions.

say_en.text: How to use IK for foot placement on uneven terrain?
say_en.note: Claude will explain IK approach and implementation.

say_en.text: What's the difference between blend trees and state machines?
say_en.note: Claude will compare their use cases.
